row.evidence: Showpad's pricing page lists Professional, Advanced and Expert with 'Request a quote' only; its SCIM 2.0 docs give the base endpoint https://{{subdomain}}.showpad.biz/api/Users/scim/v2, and the Okta SCIM guide lists 'Plan: eOS Expert, eOS Advanced, eOS Professional'.
row.notes: Quote-only: Showpad publishes no prices (all three eOS plans are 'Request a quote', licensed per user), so SCIM is only obtainable through sales. New row. Plan gate conflicts: the help-centre Okta and Entra SCIM guides say eOS Professional, Advanced and Expert, while the developer portal's SCIM page says 'Ultimate with Enterprise add-on | Advanced or Expert'; scim_plan uses the lowest plan the help centre names. SSO ('Single Sign-On for secure and simple access') is included in every plan. SCIM uses an Admin App API token (optional expiry); Okta and JumpCloud have catalogue apps with SCIM, Entra uses a non-gallery enterprise app (the gallery app is SSO with JIT only). Deprovisioning deactivates via PATCH active=false; DELETE permanently removes the user. Other provisioning: SAML JIT auto-provisioning, twice-daily SFTP CSV sync, Salesforce auto-provisioning, and the v3 REST user API, which the developer portal says works on any plan although the pricing page lists the API/SDK Developer Bundle under Advanced.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: SCIM per help centre (developer portal SCIM page names only Advanced/Expert); user API per developer portal 'Any Showpad plan'.

auth.token_source: Admin App > Settings > Integrations > API > API Tokens (after toggling SCIM on under Settings > Sign-On)
auth.token_expiry: optional expiry date set by the admin

operations.notes: POST/GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE documented for /Users and /Groups; reactivation via Okta reassignment.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users are kept and can be reactivated; DELETE (e.g. Entra with Delete checked) permanently removes the user and all associated data.

filtering.notes: Only eq on username; group filtering not implemented.

roles.how: roles attribute (owner, admin, tablet, manager); manager coaching groups via entitlements type coach_for_group

limitations.text: Filtering supports only eq on username; groups cannot be filtered.
Every new user is placed in the default 'All Users' group, which cannot be removed.

scim.notes: Okta guide asks admins to set up SSO with Okta first (c22) but the generic SCIM docs do not state SSO as a requirement, so sso_required is left null.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 (access tokens last 1 hour) or personal API tokens.

endpoints.purpose: Update a user; isActive false deactivates, true reactivates
Add users to a user group (v3)

limitations.text: User creation, update and deletion require API v3; v4 is read-only for users.

user_api.notes: Pricing page puts the 'Developer Bundle to Build Custom Apps (API/SDK, Webhooks, Reporting API)' in Advanced, and the webhooks docs say Advanced/Expert; the user-management docs say any plan (see conflicts).

okta.notes: OIN page (updated Jun. 12 2026) marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SAML SSO with JIT; Showpad documents SCIM through a non-gallery enterprise app with the generic endpoint (idp.entra = via_generic).

google.notes: Google is OAuth sign-in only and Showpad says auto-provisioning is not supported for it.

onelogin.notes: Showpad's OneLogin guide covers a custom SAML connector; the SCIM docs name OneLogin as a supported SCIM IdP but give no OneLogin SCIM guide.

fallbacks.other_sync: SFTP CSV provisioning (twice-daily sync of users and groups); Salesforce user auto-provisioning
